name: Outlook Core
description: Microsoft Graph sign-in and calendar registry for the outlook_* widget family. Sign in once with the device-code flow on this plugin's admin page; the outlook_* widgets then read your calendars through it. One Graph call per calendar, cached 10 minutes.

settings.name: client_id
settings.label: Entra application (client) ID
settings.help: Register an app in the Microsoft Entra admin center, enable 'Allow public client flows', and grant the delegated Calendars.Read, offline_access and User.Read permissions. The client ID is not a secret.

settings.name: tenant
settings.label: Tenant
settings.help: 'common' for both work/school and personal accounts, 'organizations' for work/school only, 'consumers' for personal only, or a tenant GUID to pin one directory.

settings.name: read_shared
settings.label: Read calendars shared with me
settings.help: Off by default. Turn on only if you want calendars another person owns and shared with you; your own calendars work either way. This asks for the extra Calendars.Read.Shared permission at sign-in, which some organisations require an administrator to approve — if sign-in then fails, turn this back off. Changing this takes effect at the next sign-in.
